title: Day trail: kingfisher at the lake
storyboard: Film: naturalist to camera at a Bengaluru lake edge, then the kingfisher on its perch; 2 takes

scenes.headline: Look low, over still water
scenes.body: Most sightings are a turquoise flash low over water. Learn its high, shrill whistle.

scenes.headline: It just pulled out a feather
scenes.body: Preening keeps feathers in shape. This one plucked a loose feather and dropped it.

scenes.headline: Bring binoculars and quiet feet
scenes.body: Our Bengaluru day trails start early, when the lakes are calm.

caption:
Our naturalist heard this kingfisher before anyone saw it.

Common kingfishers are often the only small blue kingfisher over much of their range, so a blue-and-orange flash over a lake is usually this species.

Source: eBird (Cornell Lab), Common Kingfisher. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Storyboard: naturalist piece-to-camera is a PIP placeholder; CC kingfisher clips stand in for our lake footage. Builds trust and ties to Muddy Lessons day trails without prices or dates.
